description:
☕⚡ Coffee Coffee Buzz Buzz Buzz | INSANELY Caffeinated Ninja Creami Ice Cream

This one is not for the faint of heart (or week of heart).

Today I’m making Coffee Coffee Buzz Buzz Buzz in the Ninja Creami — an ultra-caffeinated coffee ice cream designed to deliver maximum flavour and maximum buzz.
We’re talking LOTS of real coffee, real caffeine, and a texture that’s smooth, creamy, and dangerously easy to eat.

If you love coffee, espresso desserts, or you’ve ever thought “this ice cream should hit harder” — this one’s for you.

⚠️ Consume responsibly. This is basically frozen motivation.

⸻

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS

00:00 – Intro (⚡ why this one is intense)
00:47 – The ice cream base ingredients and Coffee fudge ingredients
01:41 – Making the base
03:55 – The Coffee Fudge
06:15 – Spin time + choppy choppy
05:02 – First spin results
07:21 – Dish up and reveal
07:32 – Taste test and Outro

⸻

🧊 EQUIPMENT USED

• Ninja Creami
• Freezer (overnight freeze recommended)
• Simple pan and baking sheet

⸻

☕ WHO THIS IS FOR

✔ Coffee addicts
✔ Espresso dessert lovers
✔ Ninja Creami owners
✔ Anyone who thinks vanilla is boring
❌ People sensitive to caffeine (seriously)

⸻

🔔 SUBSCRIBE

If you like science-based ice cream, bold flavours, and recipes that actually work — hit subscribe and turn on notifications.

⸻

comments.text: Righty! this turned out amazingly - I was about 20ml shy on the cream due to only buying the small carton. I split it into two creami tubs so it was about three quarters of the way up to the max line. My regular ninja creami shook a fair bit as it was spinning and it ended up as a kind of whirled column in the centre of the container. I'd imagine it was frozen a bit too hard or I should have left it out for a few minutes before spinning?
comments.author: @joconnell

comments.text: That usually happens when it’s frozen slightly off upright.
